title: Master Monday missing-registry status integrity
objective: Ensure a missing or invalid experiment registry is represented as unavailable evidence and cannot be collapsed into an empty matured-outcome list that produces PENDING_MATURED_OUTCOMES.

evidence.summary: PR 560 correctly introduced UNAVAILABLE_API_CONTRACT for future operational-translation outputs, but review identified a separate missing-registry fallback that can still look like a valid empty matured-outcome set.
Publication status depends on whether the matured-outcome payload is present, so the upstream registry availability state must remain explicit.
Fresh control-plane main used for routing.

reproduction: Build weekly calibration context with a missing or invalid experiment registry. Verify whether the context emits a structurally valid empty matured-outcome list and the publisher consequently selects PENDING_MATURED_OUTCOMES instead of an explicit unavailable status.

positive: A valid registry with zero newly matured outcomes remains PENDING_MATURED_OUTCOMES.
A missing, unreadable or contract-invalid registry produces an explicit unavailable status.
Future pointer and report surfaces retain the distinction.
negative: Unavailable registry evidence cannot be represented as a valid empty outcome set.
Historical W34 persisted artifacts are not rewritten.
No market or portfolio semantics change.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main already preserves registry availability end to end and negative controls pass.
stop_condition: Stop if the fix requires rewriting frozen weekly evidence or changing calibration semantics.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if a new publication policy or canonical status contract is required.
rollback_plan: Revert only the availability-state plumbing and tests. Preserve all weekly artifacts.
